messages:
alice: Quick update — kernel warmup PR merged to canary (PR #4128). Observed ~12% p50 reduction on short seqs. Need eng-platform to confirm canary sizing for next 24h. cc @ben
ben: Saw a small spike around 10:12, can you paste the canary config? And what's the KV eviction tweak you mentioned?
alice: Sure, canary config below:
```
canary:
  pool: small-gpu
  instances: 5
  rollout: 10%
  tags: [continuous-batching, kernel-tiling]
```
alice: KV note: prefetch + async warmup is enabled in canary, but eviction still conservative.
carmen: KV prefetch tweak landed in `kv-prefetch-async` — disabled eager-evict, TTL=60s. Synthetic tests: cache hit 78% -> 87%. Need longer seq perf runs.
dave: @infra-bot can you schedule a temporary canary resize if we need more headroom?
infra-bot: scheduled resize request queued — target 10 instances at 1719999800, pending approval from infra team.
pm-lina: Quick exec ask — are we still on track for Aug 4 kernel stable milestone? Need one-liner for the weekly exec note.
alice: still targeting Aug 4; if KV regression appears we might shift by a week. I'll flag risk on the roadmap and add to the risk board. Also, @ben can you review PR #4128 (left two tiny comments)?
ben: will review by EOD.
ben: Quick question — does continuous-batching change the batching window default?
alice: increases max window from 8ms -> 12ms; adaptive mode still enforces target latency ~45ms.
carmen: added perf dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/runtime/canary-1719998765 (graphs: p50/p95, cache_hit, kv_miss_rate)
dave: reminder: add `runtime.kernel.latency_p50` to tracing spans and update the alert rule if p95 increases > 20% vs baseline.
alice: thanks all — I’ll post canary metrics tomorrow morning and follow up on the PR. :thumbsup:
